objective: Verify whether the Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver product has the claimed battery platform 18v-system property in addition to its base properties (voltage 12 V, battery platform 12v-system, kit contents starter kit).

params.product_discovery: Search product_variants for brand 'Metabo' and product_name containing 'Brushless BS 1OW-IK5' to obtain the SKU. Then query product_variant_properties for that SKU to retrieve all property_key, property_value_text pairs. Verify that the base properties (voltage=12 V, battery platform=12v-system, kit contents=starter kit) are present. Then check if battery platform=18v-system is also present.
